text:
josh: quick question — correlation chip order in drilldown feels weird when exporting. currently "Trace ID • Request ID • Correlation ID". Thoughts? :thinking:
anya: agree. feels like Correlation ID should be first for copy workflows. also SR label "Copy corr id" is long.
leon: Re: ordering — if we surface copy affordance near pill, we can keep metadata order less important. keyboard access?
maria: a11y: copying via keyboard needs a clear focus ring + aria-live announcement "Correlation ID copied". also ensure exported CSV has column "correlation_id" (snake_case).
uxbot: snippet suggestion: `aria-label="Copy correlation id" role="button"` :thumbsup:
anya: also accessibility: screen reader reads "Trace ID, comma, request ID..." which is noisy. maybe add visually hidden separators and sr-only text like "Labels:" before list.
josh: proposal: reorder to "Correlation ID • Trace ID • Request ID", add inline copy icon with `aria-label="Copy correlation id"`, and keyboard shortcut `c` when pill focused to copy.
leon: implementation question: focus target should be the whole chip, not just icon, so Tab lands on chip and Enter/c to copy.
maria: export action: add checkbox "include correlation id" in export modal; default on. Also add header "correlation_id" and pad to fixed width?
anya: copy text tweak: change "Copy corr id" -> "Copy correlation ID" to be explicit. shorter alt: "Copy ID". prefer explicit.
josh: agreed. can we update copy in console and export CSV header? Design: anya will mock. dev: leon will prototype. @maria can we check logstash mappings for CSV export fields?
maria: yes, will confirm mapping. will also add aria-live flash on copy.
leon: quick dev note: copying long IDs — include a "Copy with surrounding context" option? maybe overkill.
anya: ok mock will include small SR-only tooltip and focus style. attaching quick image in thread later.
josh: thanks all. next steps: anya mock by EOD Thu, leon follow-up PR next week, maria confirm export fields. :rocket:
